step_type: Re-analysis of existing IPD (no new data collection)
question: Does baseline MRI inflammatory burden modify the effect of methotrexate, or only predict progression?
data_or_record: TREAT EARLIER randomised trial: 236 randomised, 217 (92%) completed 4-year follow-up, 182 (77%) ACPA-negative; RAMRIS-scored baseline MRI already exists for all participants
custodian_access_route: Deidentified participant data on request to the corresponding author, considered on an individual basis; no public repository. 2-year SAP and protocol already published
analysis_or_action: Cox model on progression to clinical arthritis over 4 years with a treatment x continuous MRI-burden interaction term, all 236 randomised; secondary: apply the published 1-year responder definition to the PLACEBO arm and compare PPV/NPV with the published methotrexate-arm values
strengthen_criterion: Interaction term significant with effect concentrated at higher burden AND placebo-arm PPV materially lower than the published methotrexate-arm PPV (77-79%)
falsify_criterion: No interaction AND placebo-arm PPV similar to methotrexate-arm PPV: burden is prognostic, not predictive, and the interception hypothesis loses its stated basis
immediate_next_decision: If predictive: decide whether an imaging-burden-selected interception trial is warranted and read the selection threshold off the interaction analysis. No further downstream planning at this stage
main_barrier: Access is discretionary; the analysis must be preregistered given the post-hoc history of this subgroup; power is limited by event count (13 events in the ACPA-negative increased-risk stratum); risk category and MRI burden are collinear
source_verified: Lancet Rheumatol 2024 4-year analysis (data-sharing statement, Findings); RMD Open 2025 responder analysis (PMID 41558803)

step_type: Retrieval of missing evidence (records request, no analysis)
question: Was the TRAFIC phase 2a efficacy stage ever conducted, and does any human efficacy or synovial pharmacodynamic result exist?
data_or_record: ISRCTN36667085: target size 39 (part 1 up to 21, part 2 n=18), actual enrolment 15, recruitment status 'No longer recruiting', completion recorded 31/12/2023, only publication linked is the 2021 phase 1b paper (PMID 33928262). The 2021 paper itself describes phase 2a as 'ongoing'
custodian_access_route: Sponsor Newcastle Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust / Newcastle Clinical Trials Unit; funder MRC grant MR/L005123/1 final report
analysis_or_action: Direct enquiry to sponsor/CTU and retrieval of the MRC end-of-grant report to establish whether part 2 enrolled, was terminated, or was never opened; if it ran, obtain the ACR20/EULAR, synovial sublining macrophage and RAMRIS outcomes
strengthen_criterion: Phase 2a ran and shows a synovial pharmacodynamic or clinical signal at the maximum tolerated dose: human proof of mechanism for stromal targeting exists
falsify_criterion: Phase 2a ran and showed no synovial pharmacodynamic effect at the MTD: the stromal-targeting direction is substantially weakened independent of any patient-selection question
immediate_next_decision: If it never ran: the human proof-of-mechanism question is simply open and the next step is RL-02-B, not a new trial. If it ran with results: decide whether those results justify pursuing selection at all
main_barrier: Registry enrolment fields can be stale, so the record is suggestive not conclusive; TRAFIC data beyond the manuscript and appendix are withheld for commercial sensitivity, so even aggregate recovery may be refused
source_verified: ISRCTN36667085 WHO-format registry record retrieved 2026-09-01; Lancet Rheumatol 2021 TRAFIC phase 1b (PMID 33928262) discussion and data-sharing statement

step_type: Biomarker validation on existing cohorts (no new patients)
question: Is a stromal-high synovial signature a distinct treatment-relevant endotype, or only a marker of B-cell-poor synovium and therefore of rituximab non-response?
data_or_record: STRAP baseline synovial RNA-seq (226 randomised: etanercept 73, tocilizumab 74, rituximab 79) and R4RA baseline synovial RNA-seq (164 randomised: rituximab 83, tocilizumab 81)
custodian_access_route: STRAP: interactive exploration interface public (strap.hpc.qmul.ac.uk), raw data on request to the corresponding author. R4RA: interactive interface (r4ra.hpc.qmul.ac.uk), anonymised raw data held in a non-public repository, requests to the corresponding author
analysis_or_action: Define a drug-agnostic stromal/fibroblast score on baseline synovial RNA-seq in one cohort, lock it, apply it unchanged to the other, and test its association with non-response separately within each drug arm; power calculation to be done before requesting data
strengthen_criterion: The locked score transfers to the held-out cohort and is associated with non-response to at least two mechanistically distinct drug classes, not only rituximab
falsify_criterion: The association is confined to rituximab, or the score fails to transfer: stromal-high is a B-cell-poor marker rather than a separate endotype and no stromal-signature-selected trial is justified
immediate_next_decision: If the score transfers: decide whether a prospective signature-stratified biopsy study is justified, and only then whether any stromal-directed agent is available to test in it
main_barrier: STRAP and R4RA come from the same investigator group with overlapping pipelines and STRAP models were already validated in R4RA, so cross-cohort transfer is only partly independent; published classifiers cannot be reused because they were built to predict response to specific drugs; multidrug-resistant subsets are small
source_verified: Lancet Rheumatol 2023 STRAP primary (PMID 38251532); Lancet 2021 R4RA primary; Nat Med 2022 R4RA biomarker analysis; Nat Commun 2025 STRAP deep profiling (data-availability statements read in full text)
